name: Real Estate
headline: Real-estate AI that moves every lead, property, and transaction forward
description: Automate lead response, property information, qualification, scheduling, document intake, transaction tasks, tenant service, and portfolio reporting.
challenge: Real-estate teams manage urgent inquiries, fragmented listing data, appointments, documents, vendors, financing, and long transaction checklists. Slow response and missing follow-up lose opportunities while duplicated records hide the true pipeline.
approach: Codestra creates an authoritative journey from inquiry to completed transaction or service case. We validate and deduplicate leads, enrich property context, automate bounded follow-up, schedule tasks, and preserve consent and agent ownership in the CRM.
outcomes: Faster response to qualified property demand
Consistent follow-up and appointment preparation
Fewer missing transaction documents and tasks
Clear pipeline and service visibility across teams

faqs.question: Can AI qualify real-estate leads?
faqs.answer: It can capture goals, timing, property preferences, location, budget range, and financing status, then score against approved sales criteria without using protected characteristics.

faqs.question: Can the system schedule property viewings?
faqs.answer: Yes. It can check approved calendars and listing availability, confirm contact details, create reminders, and update the CRM while routing conflicts or special access needs to an agent.

faqs.question: Can AI answer questions about listings?
faqs.answer: Yes, when answers are grounded in current authorized listing and property documents. It should cite the source and defer legal, valuation, condition, and financing judgments to qualified professionals.

name: Construction
headline: Construction AI that connects field evidence, documents, and project decisions
description: Improve estimating support, bid intake, document control, field reporting, inspections, RFIs, submittals, safety workflows, scheduling, and cost visibility.
challenge: Construction information moves through plans, photos, emails, change orders, vendor documents, field notes, and multiple project systems. Delayed or missing evidence creates rework, disputes, schedule risk, and weak cost visibility.
approach: Codestra links each workflow to project, location, trade, contract, and responsible party. Documents and field evidence remain attached to decisions, exceptions enter owner queues, and AI assists preparation without approving safety or contractual changes.
capabilities: Field report, photo, and inspection intelligence
Schedule, change, task, and cost exception workflows
outcomes: Faster routing of project questions and evidence
Reduced manual document classification and re-entry
Earlier visibility into schedule and cost exceptions
Clear responsibility and history for project decisions

faqs.question: Can AI read plans and construction documents?
faqs.answer: It can extract and compare defined information from supported documents, but outputs require source links, revision awareness, and professional verification before contractual, engineering, or safety use.

faqs.question: Can field photos be connected to project records?
faqs.answer: Yes. Mobile capture can attach time, project, location, task, and authorized metadata, run defined visual checks, and preserve the original image for review and evidence.

faqs.question: Can construction workflows work with existing project software?
faqs.answer: Yes. We integrate through supported APIs and file interfaces, define which platform owns each record, and avoid duplicate update loops between project, accounting, CRM, and document systems.

name: E-commerce
headline: E-commerce AI that improves discovery, service, and operating efficiency
description: Build product discovery, merchandising, customer service, content operations, fraud review, order workflows, retention, and demand intelligence for online commerce.
challenge: E-commerce teams manage changing catalogs, high-intent searches, promotions, customer questions, order exceptions, returns, and fragmented channel data. Poor AI can recommend unavailable products or create unsupported policy answers.
approach: Codestra grounds experiences in current catalog, inventory, customer, order, and policy data. We design recommendation and support workflows with permissions, fallback, experimentation, and measures tied to conversion, resolution, return, and margin.
capabilities: Semantic product search and guided discovery
outcomes: Faster product discovery for high-intent shoppers
Reduced repetitive catalog and service work
Better handling of order and return exceptions
Experiments measured against conversion and margin

faqs.question: Can AI improve product search without changing the commerce platform?
faqs.answer: Yes. A search and retrieval layer can index the authorized catalog, attributes, inventory, and content while the existing commerce platform remains authoritative for price, availability, cart, and order.

faqs.question: How are recommendations evaluated?
faqs.answer: We measure relevance, diversity, availability, conversion, average order value, margin, return rate, and customer feedback, with controlled experiments and merchandising constraints.

faqs.question: Can the support assistant access an order?
faqs.answer: After customer authentication, it can retrieve minimum order context and perform allowlisted actions such as status explanation or return initiation under policy and audit controls.

name: Retail
headline: Retail AI that connects stores, inventory, service, and demand
description: Apply forecasting, task automation, visual intelligence, associate assistance, customer service, inventory workflows, and promotion operations across retail channels.
challenge: Retail decisions depend on local demand, inventory accuracy, promotions, labor, supplier timing, returns, and customer behavior. Data arrives at different speeds, while store teams need simple actions rather than another dashboard.
approach: Codestra turns signals into role-specific tasks and decisions. Forecasts and alerts are calibrated to the location and horizon, inventory and visual evidence is validated, and associates receive prioritized action with feedback captured at completion.
capabilities: Shelf, display, and loss-prevention vision assistance
outcomes: Earlier response to demand and inventory exceptions
Less manual reporting and task coordination
More consistent execution across locations
Operational feedback connected to forecasts and plans

faqs.question: Can AI forecast demand by store and product?
faqs.answer: Yes, when sufficient history and context exist. Models can include seasonality, promotions, holidays, local patterns, stockouts, and external signals with accuracy tracked by horizon and segment.

faqs.question: How can computer vision help stores?
faqs.answer: Defined visual checks can assist shelf availability, display compliance, queue or traffic insight, and asset inspection. Privacy, camera placement, false alarms, and human review are designed first.

faqs.question: Can store teams receive tasks on mobile devices?
faqs.answer: Yes. Prioritized tasks can include location, evidence, due time, instructions, and completion capture, with offline-aware behavior and escalation for unresolved exceptions.

name: Logistics
headline: Logistics AI that keeps orders, capacity, documents, and exceptions moving
description: Build automation for quoting, order intake, carrier and vendor coordination, tracking, document processing, exception management, billing, and customer communication.
challenge: Logistics teams reconstruct status from calls, emails, portals, EDI, telematics, and documents. Delayed updates and duplicated entry hide exceptions until service or margin has already been affected.
approach: Codestra establishes an authoritative shipment or order timeline, normalizes external events, turns exceptions into owned tasks, and uses AI for extraction, classification, summaries, ETA assistance, and communication preparation.
capabilities: Order, quote, and carrier intake automation
BOL, POD, invoice, and receipt processing
Exception, SLA, billing, and customer communication
outcomes: Faster order setup and document completion
Earlier detection of service exceptions
Less manual status gathering and re-entry
Clearer service, cost, and margin visibility

faqs.question: Can Codestra connect telematics and carrier tracking providers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Provider events are verified, normalized into an internal tracking model, deduplicated, and linked to shipments, legs, stops, and exceptions without coupling operations to one provider schema.

faqs.question: Can AI extract data from BOL and POD documents?
faqs.answer: Yes. The pipeline can classify, extract, validate, attach source evidence, and route uncertain or conflicting fields to operations before billing or delivery completion.

faqs.question: How are late shipments detected?
faqs.answer: Planned milestones are compared with verified positions, events, ETA signals, geofences, and communication state. Thresholds create an exception with owner, severity, SLA, and response workflow.

name: Transportation
headline: Transportation AI for dispatch, visibility, service, and coordinated capacity
description: Modernize dispatch, routing support, driver and carrier communication, trip visibility, safety administration, documents, billing, and customer workflows.
challenge: Transportation operations make time-sensitive decisions across drivers, vehicles, stops, passengers or freight, providers, weather, traffic, compliance, and changing service conditions. Fragmented systems make recovery reactive.
approach: Codestra models trips, loads, legs, stops, assignments, events, and exceptions explicitly. AI assists planning and communication, while dispatch authority, compliance, safety, and final assignment remain controlled and observable.
capabilities: Route, ETA, stop, and geofence visibility
Compliance, document, billing, and exception operations
outcomes: Faster dispatch preparation and exception response
Improved visibility across active transportation work
Reduced repeated calls and status checks
Traceable assignment, service, and compliance decisions

faqs.question: Can AI dispatch vehicles or carriers automatically?
faqs.answer: AI can rank feasible assignments and prepare evidence, but live assignment should respect capacity, compliance, contracts, safety, geography, human authority, and rollback controls.

faqs.question: Can the system support passenger and freight workflows?
faqs.answer: Yes, with separate domain rules. Shared capabilities include identity, scheduling, stops, communications, tracking, documents, exceptions, and billing, while operational and compliance details remain distinct.

faqs.question: Can status events flow into Odoo and n8n?
faqs.answer: Yes. Verified internal events can update CRM or operations records through adapters and trigger governed n8n workflows through durable signed delivery.

name: Manufacturing
headline: Manufacturing AI that turns production signals into focused action
description: Apply visual inspection, maintenance intelligence, production planning, document automation, knowledge, supplier workflows, and operational analytics.
challenge: Manufacturing data spans machines, quality records, work instructions, ERP, maintenance, suppliers, and operator experience. Model outputs are ineffective when they do not fit line timing, safety, quality authority, or corrective-action workflows.
approach: Codestra begins with a specific production or quality decision, validates the available signal, and integrates results into existing work orders, inspection, escalation, and root-cause processes with operator feedback and safe fallback.
capabilities: Production, demand, and material planning support
Work instruction, supplier, and quality document AI
outcomes: Earlier detection of quality and asset exceptions
More focused maintenance and inspection effort
Reduced manual production reporting
Operational learning linked to corrective actions

faqs.question: Can AI stop a production line automatically?
faqs.answer: Safety and production control require a validated control system and approved authority. AI normally begins as detection and recommendation with explicit operator or quality approval.

faqs.question: Can existing machine data be used?
faqs.answer: Yes, after assessing timestamp quality, sampling, maintenance history, operating modes, missing data, and whether the signal represents the target condition without leakage.

faqs.question: How does visual inspection handle new defects?
faqs.answer: The system needs an unknown or uncertain path. Low-confidence and out-of-distribution cases are preserved for quality review instead of being forced into a known class.

name: Automotive
headline: Automotive AI for sales, service, inspection, parts, and customer operations
description: Improve dealership and service workflows with lead response, appointment automation, visual inspection, technician knowledge, parts intelligence, and customer communication.
challenge: Automotive businesses coordinate customers, vehicles, inventory, parts, finance, technicians, inspections, warranties, and follow-up across dealership and manufacturer systems. Missing context creates delays and repeat visits.
approach: Codestra links each interaction to the correct customer, vehicle, service, and evidence record. AI assists qualification, inspection, knowledge, summaries, and recommendations while certified staff approve mechanical and financial decisions.
capabilities: Vehicle sales lead and appointment automation
Service intake, inspection, and estimate preparation
Parts, warranty, and customer follow-up workflows
outcomes: Faster response to sales and service demand
More complete service intake and evidence
Reduced technician and advisor lookup time
Consistent post-service communication and follow-up

faqs.question: Can AI inspect vehicle photos?
faqs.answer: It can assist with defined visible conditions and attach evidence to an inspection, but qualified professionals must verify safety, damage, mechanical, warranty, and valuation conclusions.

faqs.question: Can the system book service appointments?
faqs.answer: Yes. It can capture the vehicle and concern, check authorized capacity, prepare the appointment, send reminders, and route urgent or ambiguous cases to a service advisor.

faqs.question: Can this connect to a dealership management system?
faqs.answer: Yes where supported interfaces exist. We define customer and vehicle identity, record ownership, minimum data, command permissions, and reconciliation before enabling synchronization.
